title: The biggest parades, carnival clubs and brass band contracts
summary: The biggest parade had 15-16 bands; they discuss Zulu, Buzzards, Mysterious Babies and booking a year ahead.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you some more about these brass bands. What do you think is the biggest and the best parade you ever worked at?
Conover time and art fellas parade. They played like that. That's the biggest parade we played. They start 6 o'clock in the morning. They stopped around 6 o'clock that night. That's right.
How many bands would they have?
Oh, around about. That's around about. 15, 16 bands. That's a lot of bands.
That's a lot of bands. That's a lot of bands. As many they could get in these bands.
And Conover going on the RLC. You played, you played, too. When you get on them. That was the Zulu's other bands. Yeah.
The Zulu's had the Eureka this year.

That's the only one I see. But they have several of them. The Garden District and the Corner Club have brass bands. The Jefferson City Buzzards. I don't know who the Eleanor has. That's the way for them to hear me.

Yeah. For Conover's it's a place for them. For them. For them. For them. Jefferson Buzzards. And the Mysterious Baby. And 6 District Carnival Club sometimes. There's no different club like that. That's Carnival Day. Who are the Mysterious Babies? That's a club from up front of town. That's on Chapitula Street over there. Somewhere over there.
That was a white outfit? Yes.
Oh no, no, no. A beach club.
Nice squad people, huh? Mm-hmm. Bust your head. They beat them. They bust your head, huh? You didn't watch it. You went to some stocks.
I used to pay for the buzzard. Finished this column. They gave me the deposit for next year. Boy, that was true.
Next column. Yeah. Sign the contract for next year right now. As soon as you get on playing that job. You got the next job.
